metadata.case_name: KHAN IRRAM v. WAI HING ENGINEERING COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: labourer (returned to work for Wai Hing one month after the injury)

injuries.description: Fracture at the distal phalange of his left ring finger
source: X-ray of the left ring finger detected a fracture at the distal phalange.
According to the Hospital Report, the distal phalange of his left ring finger was swollen with bruises. Bruise was found underneath the fingernail of his left ring finger.

injuries.description: Injury to left middle finger (swelling/scratch reported)
source: he sustained injuries to three ulnar fingers of his left hand as a result.
his left middle finger had scratches below the fingernail; the swell of all 3 ulnar fingers had become prominent the following day after the accident

injuries.description: Injury to left little finger (part of three ulnar fingers injured)
source: he sustained injuries to three ulnar fingers of his left hand as a result.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

manifestations.description: the distal phalange of his left ring finger was swollen with bruises.
Bruise was found underneath the fingernail of his left ring finger.
The pain and tender at the tip of the ring finger with hard contact
He can no longer play cricket and volleyball after the accident.
his left middle finger had scratches below the fingernail
the swell of all 3 ulnar fingers had become prominent the following day after the accident

treatments_received: A & E attendance at Ruttonjee Hospital
X-ray of the left ring finger
Follow-up advised but patient did not turn up

losses.description: Injury to left ring finger including fracture at the distal phalange

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Can no longer play cricket and volleyball after the accident
Disadvantage on the labour market; may suffer longer periods of unemployment as a result of the injury
